title: More in the Rocks
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Two more guns rise from the rocks."

title: Twin-Pistol Rogue
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "That rogue draws iron with both hands."

title: Drunken Bandit
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "He staggers into the road with more whiskey than sense."

title: Veteran Bandit
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "This one has survived too many gunfights to be lucky."

title: Bandit’s Last Words
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "With his last breath, the bandit names a cache under a split cedar."

title: Hidden Sniper
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A second shot cracks from the ridge."

title: Posse Cheers
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Folks in town tip their hats. Law still means something out here."

title: False Badge
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The badge looks right from a distance, but close up it smells of trouble."

title: Sheriff’s Notice
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A wanted poster curls on the wall, and the sheriff is saddling up."

title: Inside Man
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A nervous teller leaves the vault latch loose."

title: Locked Vault
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The vault door groans shut. This job just got louder."

title: Dusty Getaway
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A dust storm rolls in, ugly enough to hide a desperate escape."

title: Payroll Car
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Tonight the train carries payroll, and every outlaw can smell it."

title: Railroad Guard
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A uniformed guard recognizes a lawful face and asks for help."

title: Rich Vein
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Gold dust spills out like bottled sunshine."

title: Cave-In
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The timbers crack overhead. The mine wants paid in blood today."

title: Claim Jumper’s Shadow
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Somebody watched you strike gold, and he ain’t the sharing kind."

title: Map in a Tube
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Wrapped in oilskin waits a map older than the town itself."

title: Fool’s Gold
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "That glitter in your pan is pretty, but pretty don’t always pay."

title: Banker’s Smile
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The banker smiles wide enough to show every tooth he owns."

title: Assayer Dispute
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The assayer squints at your gold and calls it light."

title: Free Spurs
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The shopkeep tosses in spurs that belonged to a fast man."

title: Gunsmith’s Favor
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The gunsmith eyes your iron and knocks ten off the price."

title: Counterfeit Goods
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The bargain looked fine in the store light. Then it starts smoking."

title: Rare Shipment
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A crate from back East lands on the counter sealed with promise."

title: Doctor’s Secret Tonic
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The doctor pours something dark and says not to ask what’s in it."

title: Bad Medicine
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The medicine works, but the room keeps standing sideways."

title: Standing Ovation
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The crowd pounds tables until the rafters shake."

title: Cabaret Scandal
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "By sunrise, half of Red Falls knows and the rest invented worse."

title: Card Shark
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A card sharp slides into the game with clean cuffs and dirty eyes."

title: Lucky Table
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "That table’s been lucky since the bullet hole got patched with silver."

title: Saloon Brawl
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A chair breaks, a bottle flies, and the cards ain’t the only trouble."

title: Honest Pay
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Honest sweat spends just fine."

title: Splintered Hand
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The handle snaps and buries a splinter deep enough to remember."

title: Stampede
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The herd bolts, hooves thunderin’ like judgment day."

title: Prize Steer
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The ranch hand points out the fattest steer in the pen."

title: Rustler’s Brand
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The brand is fresh, and every lawman will smell it."

title: Clean Drive
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Not one steer strays. That kind of work earns respect."

title: Broken Bridge
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The bridge ahead is more memory than timber."

title: Runaway Stagecoach
narrationScript: [raspy][old cowboy][western][fast][low key][emotionless][quick]A driverless stagecoach comes barreling down the road!

title: Snakebite
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A rattler strikes from a shadow no bigger than a boot heel."

title: Desert Shortcut
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "An old trail cuts through country most folks swear is impassable."

title: Dixon Creek Ambush
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Dixon Creek is quiet. Too quiet for honest country."

title: Green Ranch Greenhorn
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A young ranch hand waves you down with panic in his eyes."

title: Sunny Hills Luck
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Sunny Hills earns its name when the stone itself starts shining."

title: Signal Fire
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A signal fire burns on the ridge above Spike’s View."

title: Echo in the Cliffs
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Something answers your footsteps from deep in the rock."

title: Legendary Whisper
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Some items carry stories before they ever touch your hand."

title: Famous Deed
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "By sundown, somebody is already telling the story wrong."

title: Risk Pays
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Fortune favors the fool who knows when to run."

title: Risk Bites
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Risk has teeth, and today it found skin."

title: Loyal Crew
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A few hard faces know your name and ride cheap."

title: Frontier Cache
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Under a flat stone waits a cache left by somebody who never came back."

title: Frontier Deadfall
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The frontier gives with one hand and drops a log with the other."

title: Hunter’s Mark
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Clean work. Even the old trappers would nod at that shot."

title: Wounded Predator
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The beast falls, but not before leaving its mark."

title: Forager’s Cache
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A dry creek bed hides more than dust."

title: Spoiled Bundle
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "What looked useful in the shade smells mean in the sun."

title: Fine Craftsmanship
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "That ain’t just useful. That’s work worth remembering."

title: Broken Tool
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The tool holds together just long enough to finish the job."

title: Wood for the Station
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Fresh-cut timbers thump beside the tracks like the bones of a new town."

title: Iron for the Line
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The foreman runs a thumb along the iron and smiles like a man seeing tomorrow."

title: Eyes in the Window
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A curtain twitches across the street. Somebody saw the whole thing, and witnesses have a way of finding the sheriff."

title: A Little Extra
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Something else hits the dust in the scramble: a small purse nobody noticed until now."

title: A Crowd Gathers
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Boots scrape porches and saloon doors swing open. Folks smell a fight, and wagers start changing hands."

title: Dust in the Eyes
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A hard gust throws grit between the fighters. For half a heartbeat, neither one can see straight."

title: Public Example
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The sheriff marches the prisoner through the middle of town where everybody can see how the day ended."

title: Loose Cuffs
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The sheriff's cuffs have seen better years, and so has the deputy watching the prisoner's pockets."

title: Friendly Conductor
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The conductor recognizes a familiar face and passes along a useful bit of news before the whistle blows."

title: Late Freight
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A freight car rolls in behind schedule and short on hands. Ten dollars buys a few minutes of honest work."

title: Rockslide
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Stone cracks loose above the trail and the whole mountain seems to come down at once."

title: Abandoned Cache
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Beneath a stack of trail stones sits a weathered cache left by somebody who never came back for it."

title: A Man Near Death
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A half-starved prospector stumbles from the sagebrush, clutching a leather poke. He offers twenty dollars for a drink and a ride to town."

title: Debt Repaid
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The old prospector steps from the corner and lays coins on the counter. I told ya I would repay kindness."

title: The Man You Left Behind
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The outlaw falls and removes his hat. Beneath the grime you recognize the prospector you left in the dust. He whistles, and two more bandits crawl from the rocks."

title: Fence Line Down
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A widow in black asks for help mending a fence before rustlers find the gap."

title: A Safe Drive
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The widow’s brand rides among the herd, and every honest mile helps save her land."

title: Black Veil Bandit
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A veiled rider joins the rustlers. Grief has sharpened her into something dangerous."

title: Deputy for a Day
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Marshal Reeves needs a steady hand and a steadier conscience."

title: Crackdown Warrant
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Reeves has warrants stacked like firewood and enough rope for every name on them."

title: Marshal on Your Trail
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Reeves pins your name below the lantern and rides into the dark."

title: The Painted Wagon
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A painted wagon rolls into Red Falls, promising wonders, music, and lies in equal measure."

title: Grand Frontier Show
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Silas Bell calls your hand a miracle and sells tickets before the cards cool."

title: The Great Swindle
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The label says genuine. The showman’s smile says otherwise."

title: Old Pike’s Tracks
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Old Jeremiah Pike studies the tracks and grunts like the animal owed him money."

title: The White Bear Trail
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Pike points with a shaking finger. That trail belongs to something too big for ordinary fear."

title: Sprung Trap
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A hidden trap snaps shut. Pike does not forgive being ignored."

title: A Stranger at the Table
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A stranger with pale gloves sits down without asking and smiles without warmth."

title: Beating the Shark
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "For the first time all night, the stranger’s smile breaks."

title: Debt Collector
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A debt collector steps from the alley, quoting numbers no honest man remembers."

title: Surveyors Arrive
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Surveyors arrive with chains, stakes, and the dangerous idea that tomorrow can be measured."

title: Timbers for the Depot
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Fresh timbers thump beside the tracks like bones of a new town."

title: Iron for the Line
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The foreman runs a thumb along the iron and sees tomorrow."

title: Grand Opening
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "With the last spike driven, the locomotive whistles like the frontier itself just woke up."

title: Torn Journal
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "A torn journal speaks of Spanish gold hidden where the cliffs throw shadows at noon."

title: The Stone Marker
narrationScript: [raspy][old cowboy][western][fast][low key][emotionless][quick]A stone cross leans from the dust, older than any town on this map.

title: The Buried Cache
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Under red stone waits a cache of coins stamped for a king who never saw this country."

title: Strange Tracks
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Tracks wide as dinner plates cut across the prairie, and every bird has gone quiet."

title: The Warning
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "An old scout warns that some animals are not trophies. They are tests."

title: The White Buffalo Appears
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The white buffalo steps from the morning haze, bright as a ghost and heavier than legend."

title: Drought
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The wells cough mud and the sun hangs mean in the sky."

title: Gold Rush
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Gold fever spreads faster than common sense."

title: Sheriff’s Crackdown
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The law sharpens its teeth."

title: Bandit Uprising
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The hills start spitting out hard men with loaded guns."

title: Frontier Festival
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Music rolls out of town like lantern light."

title: Bad Weather
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Rain turns every road into brown soup."

title: Clear Skies
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The sky clears, and every trail looks shorter."

title: High Stakes Night
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Every fool with coin in his pocket wants a seat."

title: Cattle Market
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Beef prices climb like smoke."

title: Doctor Shortage
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The doctor is short on laudanum and patience."

title: Railroad Jubilee
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The locomotive whistles and every station celebrates."

title: Armed Train Guards
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Railroad men hire guns by the dozen."

title: Unstable Mines
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The earth groans under every pick."

title: Trader Boom
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Dr. Herve’s wagon rolls heavy with wonders."

title: Dry Saloons
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The whiskey runs dry and the tables go cold."

title: Ranch Fire
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Smoke rises from the north pasture."

title: Useful Scraps
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The frontier is littered with things useful to clever hands."

title: Predator Migration
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Hungry eyes shine in the brush."

title: Craft Fair
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "Every useful trinket finds a buyer."

title: Red Sunset
narrationScript: [western storyteller][old cowboy][raspy] "The sunset burns red, and even ordinary deeds look legendary."
